# Danceify

> Danceify is an iOS app that turns one photo into a 10-second AI dance video of a person, baby, dog or cat, in any of 17 dance styles, with music. No sign-up. Free to download; videos use coins (coin packs from $2.99, or a weekly plan). App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760788471

## What the app does

- Upload one photo, choose who is dancing (PERSON, BABY, DOG or CAT) and a dance style, and the app makes a 10-second video of that subject dancing, with a music track, saved to your camera roll.
- The AI keeps the face, hair, skin tone and clothing (or the breed, fur and markings) from the photo; it animates your subject rather than swapping a face onto another dancer.
- Dogs and cats dance upright on their hind legs; baby mode keeps baby proportions and age.
- The video is rendered on Danceify's servers; the app shows an estimate while it renders, typically a few minutes. If a video fails to render, its coins are returned automatically.
- 17 dance styles: EDM Shuffle, Salsa, TikTok Viral, Bollywood, Samba, Greek Dance, Hip-Hop, Ballet, Tango, Flamenco, Reggaeton, Swing, Belly Dance, Hula, Country Line, K-Pop, Irish Dance. Each style has separate choreography for people, babies, dogs and cats.
- Platform: iOS (iPhone). No Android or web version. English.
- Uploaded photos are deleted from Danceify's storage within hours (see the privacy policy).

## Who it is for

- Dog and cat owners who want a video of their pet dancing.
- Parents and grandparents making a dancing baby video for the family group chat.
- Anyone who wants to turn a photo of themselves or a friend into a TikTok-, Reels- or Stories-ready dance clip.

## Pricing

- Free to download; no account, email or password.
- Videos use coins. One-time coin packs start from $2.99 and never expire. The weekly plan refills coins every week and can be cancelled anytime in iPhone Settings.
- Prices are in US dollars; the App Store shows the local price. Payment and refunds go through Apple.
